items.rationale: The washing-machine leak qualifies as escape of water under §2.4.2. Section 7.1.7(h) covers necessary cleaning of the affected floor; €80 is this line's share of the comparable Case 12 work.
The hallway floor was also reached by the escaping water, so necessary cleaning is covered under §§7.1.5 and 7.1.7(h). Allow €95 for this area, calibrated to Case 12.
Section 7.1.7(e) expressly covers checking the source and confirming that it no longer leaks, even if the appliance itself is uninsured. Allow €75 for the connection check, not appliance repair.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged skirting
items.rationale: Necessary removal and disposal of damaged fixed trim is covered under §§4.2.2 and 7.1.7(a). Allow €65 for the combined work, consistent with the Case 12 bundle.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 allow like-for-like replacement. The €150 allowance brings the first five lines to €465, within the comparable Case 12 range of €423–514.

items.description: Clean and repaint unaffected upstairs bedroom
items.rationale: Sections 3.5 and 7.1.5 exclude work in the upstairs bedroom because it was not affected by the leak.

items.description: Measure moisture in both affected floors
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(b) covers moisture measurement in both affected rooms. Allow €165 for the combined survey, consistent with Case 21.
Section 7.1.7(b) covers necessary drying, but §7.1.8(c) bars duplication of separately billed rental or labour. Allow €125 for distinct drying work only.

Section 7.1.7(e) covers equipment hire for the affected floors, provided it is not already included in line 8. Allow €200 for hire, bringing the four covered drying-invoice estimates to €642, in line with Case 12.
Section 7.1.7(g) covers necessary trade labour, subject to the duplicate-charge exclusion in §7.1.8(c). The four-hour prior gives 4 × €38 = €152.

items.description: Measure and dry unaffected basement storage room
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) restrict drying to spaces with affected components. No leak damage was documented in the basement storage room.

Section 5.2.6 covers specialist transport only from the balance of the €1,190 gross per-item limit after restoration. Restoration is expected to exhaust that limit; €85 is the transport allowance if sufficient balance remains.
The assessment qualifies under §5.2.6, but payment comes after restoration and the preceding transport line. Allow €140 if enough of the shared €1,190 gross limit remains.
Section 5.2.6 covers stabilisation, but this line receives only the balance left after restoration, transport and assessment. If any balance remains, estimate a partial allowance of €150.

Section 5.2.6 gives restoration first priority under the shared cap for this assessed, unscheduled painting. Full specialist restoration is likely to reach the €1,000 net limit, or €1,190 gross at 19% VAT.
Section 4.3(d) excludes movable artwork from property cover, and §5.2.6 does not reimburse conservation of an item unaffected by the insured event.
Section 7.1.8(b) expressly excludes separate administrative, handling and processing charges; §5.2.6 does not provide a separate allowance for them.
